primaryStatutoryAuthority.description: A youth offender, meaning a person who was 24 or younger at the time of the offense, may move to set aside the conviction after completing probation, incarceration, supervised release or parole, whichever is later, regardless of whether they were sentenced under the Act.

The factors the court considers on a discretionary set-aside. The pin records the current content of these factors, and current Superior Court practice for such motions, as an unresolved build blocker.
A certificate issues in any case where the conviction is set aside.

counselFlags: Automatic relief caution: DC has automatic record relief for some records, but processing is phased in and may not be complete until October 1, 2027. This workflow should not treat automatic relief as completed record clearing.
Prosecutor identity: Serve the correct prosecutor: the U.S. Attorney's Office for DC or the DC Office of the Attorney General, depending on the case.
Eligibility exclusions: Master Grid Group 1-3 felony convictions are not eligible for by-motion sealing.
Records scope: DC record relief reaches DC records, not federal records or records from other jurisdictions.
DC motion verification is a declaration under penalty of perjury; confirm the exact declaration/notarization form with counsel and current Superior Court practice.

DRAFTING BARRED. The pin records four build blockers on this track and its filing rule reads, verbatim: "Blocked pending confirmation of Superior Court form or standing practice for YRA set-aside motions." Lane C2 does not draft a replica of an instrument whose form, service mechanics and composition the source leaves open. No motion, no fixtures and no rendered artifacts are produced, and no participant-facing filing instructions are shipped, because shipping them would imply a packet that does not exist.

A set-aside is not sealing. Even once this route is unblocked, the person still needs a separate motion to seal the associated arrest and case records — and whether the two are filed together or in sequence is itself one of the unresolved build blockers.

Related automatic relief recorded in the pin: an unconditional discharge of a committed youth offender before expiration of the sentence automatically sets aside the conviction, and automatic set-aside follows early termination of supervised release by the Parole Commission. A participant may already have the relief without any motion, which is the first thing counsel should check.
A certificate issues in any case where the conviction is set aside.
DC motion verification is a declaration under penalty of perjury; confirm the exact declaration/notarization form with counsel and current Superior Court practice.

Immigration, firearm, licensing, security clearance, childcare, healthcare, or law enforcement employment consequences are in play.

The pinned entry's filing rule reads "Blocked pending confirmation of Superior Court form or standing practice for YRA set-aside motions", and the pin carries four build blockers reaching the governing factors and current practice, the service and response mechanics, the composition of the packet, and whether the court has any form or standing practice at all. blockedPleading.whatIsSettled: The authority, the eligible population and the trigger. A person who was 24 or younger at the time of the offense may move to set aside the conviction after completing probation, incarceration, supervised release or parole, whichever is later, regardless of whether they were sentenced under the Act. The relief is discretionary: the court considers the statutory factors and makes a written statement on the record of its reasons. Venue is the Superior Court's Criminal Division, one motion per case number. A certificate issues where the conviction is set aside.
blockedPleading.whatIsBarred: The instrument itself.
